description: Future versions of known families are priced with the newest known version of the family (opus 6 -> Opus 5.5, sonnet 7.2 -> Sonnet 5.5, haiku 6 -> Haiku 5.5, fable 9.9 -> Fable 5.1) and get their own row. Ids of an unknown family, <synthetic> and other vendors have no price and are left out of the totals (unpricedCalls).
